hypothesis: A fresh Krown RSI-EMA color turn aligned with the default 21/55 EMA trend can identify bidirectional BRENTOIL trend resumption after costs without reusing Range Onset, Swing/HA, breakout-pressure, EMA55-touch, or oil-shock reversion.
why_this_is_distinct: the trigger is a fresh RSI-EMA slope/color transition rather than a persistent RSI value
the entry does not require BBWP, PMARP, an EMA55 touch, a range boundary, a price shock, or L2 pressure
the primary exit is the opposite completed RSI-EMA color transition rather than a fixed take-profit or the retired provider exits

source_contract.translation_disclosure: The Pine files define indicators, not an executable strategy. The conjunction, entry timing, exits, stop, and maximum hold below are predeclared research hypotheses rather than source-authored rules.

frozen_strategy.long_entry: completed close above EMA21 above EMA55; RSI above RSI-EMA; RSI-EMA at or above 50; RSI-EMA slope turns from non-positive to positive
frozen_strategy.short_entry: completed close below EMA21 below EMA55; RSI below RSI-EMA; RSI-EMA at or below 50; RSI-EMA slope turns from non-negative to negative
frozen_strategy.entry_execution: first exact executable L2 quote of the next completed 15m bucket
frozen_strategy.long_exit: first completed bar whose RSI-EMA slope turns non-positive or EMA21 is no longer above EMA55, then next executable quote
frozen_strategy.short_exit: first completed bar whose RSI-EMA slope turns non-negative or EMA21 is no longer below EMA55, then next executable quote

frozen_friction.stress_basis: maximum absolute observed BRENTOIL live-canary slippage across six mixed-strategy fill observations
frozen_friction.funding: exact locally frozen hourly venue funding
frozen_friction.fills: next-bar exact L2 bid/ask with venue mark path for stop/liquidation risk

evaluation_protocol.chronology: reuse the canonical 60/20/20 HIP-3 archive windows but evaluate development only
evaluation_protocol.technical_failure_behavior: abort without evaluating validation or holdout and without selecting a replacement
evaluation_protocol.economic_failure_behavior: publish the losing result and mark the hypothesis rejected; do not retune

comparison_baselines: do nothing and continue v52 unchanged
continue passive BRENTOIL oil-shock shadow collection
retired BRENTOIL Swing/HA and breakout-pressure evidence
previous crypto Krown pullback and EMA55-touch development failures
success_interpretation: Positive development stress economics, both-side robustness, majority-positive folds, positive stress net without the largest winner, zero liquidations, and resolved lifecycle paths would support opening a separately approved untouched validation step; it would not support live activation.
falsifier: Any negative stress net, non-positive stress result without the largest winner, one-sided failure, majority-negative folds, liquidation, unresolved selected lifecycle path, or source/hash mismatch rejects or technically invalidates this frozen development hypothesis.
limitations: BRENTOIL history is short and development evidence is hypothesis formation
the stress tail comes from only six mixed-strategy live slippage observations
no fixed take-profit is assumed; the opposite-turn exit can surrender open profit
a positive development result would still be vulnerable to selection bias and requires untouched validation plus prospective execution parity
this record grants no live asset, strategy, sizing, leverage, risk, exit, configuration, or deployment authority
